description: List terms a(n) of a sequence with their indices n. Reads the entry's b-file when it has one — often thousands of terms beyond the data line — and otherwise the data line itself. Values are exact decimal strings of any size. A slice stops at limit terms, at about 100,000 bytes, or at the end of one 1 MiB part of a larger b-file, whichever comes first; nextFromIndex continues it.

aNumber.description: OEIS A-number, e.g. "A000045"; oeis_identify_sequence and oeis_search_sequences return them. Also accepts "a000045", "A45", "45", and an oeis.org sequence URL; all normalize to the zero-padded form. Legacy M/N book numbers (e.g. "M1459") are not A-numbers: find them with oeis_search_sequences.

fromIndex.description: First index n to return; defaults to the first available index. Pass nextFromIndex from the previous call to continue.

limit.description: Maximum number of terms to return, 1–1000 (default 100). A slice stops sooner at about 100,000 bytes of large terms or at the end of one 1 MiB part of a larger b-file; continue with nextFromIndex.

name: oeis_get_terms

bFileCut.description: True while the b-file goes on past lastAvailableIndex. Its later terms are at bFileUrl; nextFromIndex or a larger fromIndex reaches them unless the notice says only the first 1 MiB was read.

bFileSizeInBytes.description: Full size of the b-file as OEIS reported it; absent when not reported.

bFileUrl.description: URL of the b-file the terms came from; absent when source is data.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `sequence_not_found`: No OEIS entry exists for the requested A-number. `pacer_shed`: The oeis.org request queue would exceed its wait budget. `upstream_rate_limited`: oeis.org answered HTTP 429 Too Many Requests on the b-file or the record and retries within the call did not clear it. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

firstAvailableIndex.description: Lowest index n read for this entry; absent when no terms were read.

lastAvailableIndex.description: Highest index n read so far for this entry; when bFileCut is true the b-file goes on past it. Absent when no terms were read.

nextFromIndex.description: Pass as fromIndex for the next slice. Absent when no slice follows this one: the terms ended, or the notice says how to reach the rest.

notice.description: Guidance: where the next slice starts and whether the byte budget ended this one, why no terms came back (past the last index, or not yet reached in a large b-file), that a b-file line too long to read was skipped, that only the first 1 MiB of the b-file could be read, or that the terms are data-line only.

source.description: bfile: read from the entry's b-file of extended terms. data: the entry has no b-file, so these are its data-line terms.

terms.description: Terms in index order, from the first index at or after fromIndex (or the first available index).

value.description: a(n) as an exact decimal string, sign kept.

url.description: Sequence page on oeis.org; cite it wherever the terms are reused.

title: Get OEIS Sequence Terms
